story: The name Xion is inspired by Mount Zion. For us the mountain is a symbol and a goal: a high place that people reach together.

With that goal, a group of pioneers established XionTechs in America. They set out to create a community where people unite to harness the newest technologies and build exceptional IT systems to advance humanity.
Today that community works from Plano, Texas, and from Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang in Vietnam.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Deliver cutting-edge AI-driven IT services and products that solve complex challenges, empower businesses and individuals, foster collaboration between technology and human values, and create a positive, sustainable impact worldwide.
